title: Vitamin C + E + Ferulic 16% Face Serum

facts.text: Vitamin C + E + Ferulic 16% Face Serum
Brightens & protects skin
A skin-brightening daily serum with stable Vitamin C at 15% and antioxidants (Vitamin E & Ferulic Acid) at 1% combined.
"Visibly gives me brighter and more even skin tone and helps to accelerate the fading of scars. -Meenakshi P."
Made with stabilized Vitamin C derivative "Ethyl Ascorbic Acid" (EAA) that has 86% pure Vitamin C content. This serum delivers EAA in high concentration of 15%
1% blend of 2 potent antioxidants - Vitamin E & Ferulic Acid. Together they not only stabilize the formula, but also improve efficacy of Vitamin C

Contains Fullerenes (C60), a new generation antioxidant (the scientists who discovered Fullerenes were awarded Nobel Prize). It is several times more potent than Vitamin C and has strong, long lasting and stable anti-oxidative activity
The combination of actives not only brighten the skin, but also scavenge free radicals to reduce redness, skin damage and make skin healthy overall
Formulated with ET-VC, high purity Ethyl Ascorbic Acid, from Corum Inc, Taiwan
Skin type: All skin types
Concerns : Spots, Uneven Tone & Dull Skin
Suitable for: 18+ years of age

After cleansing and toning your face, take 2-3 drops of Vitamin C serum on your fingertips with the dropper. Apply it on the face by gently tapping it on the skin. With a circular motion, evenly spread the serum and allow your skin to absorb it.
When to use: AM & PM. Everyday
A potent everyday serum with stabilised Vitamin C and new age antioxidant Fullerenes to brighten skin and make it healthy & even looking
94% subjects agreed significant improvement in skin glow & reduction in dullness
87% subjects agreed skin felt more even looking after 6 weeks
87% subjects agreed reduction in spots after 8 weeks
Note: The product has been evaluated for safety through patch testing under the supervision of a Dermatologist.
Proven antioxidant that visibly brightens dull skin and fades dark spots
New-age molecule with strong antioxidant properties to address several skin issues like dullness, UV damage, and aging
Potent antioxidant that reverses signs of sun damage (UV exposure), and makes skin look even & healthier overall

Water/Aqua, 3-O-Ethyl Ascorbic Acid, Propanediol, Ethoxydiglycol, 1,2-Hexanediol, Butylene Glycol, Dimethyl Isosorbide, Argan Oil Glycereth-8 Esters, Sodium Hyaluronate, Panthenol, Ferulic Acid, Phenoxyethanol, Sodium Gluconate, Fullerenes, Tocopheryl Acetate, Pentylene Glycol, Citric Acid, Sodium Citrate, Ethylhexylglycerin, PVP, Trisodium Ethylenediamine Disuccinate

facts.section: Which skin types is this suitable for?
facts.text: This serum is suitable for all skin types. Vitamin C is a known antioxidant and has several skin benefits. This is an everyday serum that can be easily incorporated in your daily skincare routine

facts.section: Can this product be used for men & women both?
facts.text: Yes. This face cleanser works equally well for both men and women.

facts.section: What is the recommended age for using this serum?
facts.text: Anyone over 18 years of age can use this product.
Pregnant or breastfeeding individuals should not use this product without consulting their healthcare provider first.
